params.name: page
params.description: Page number to be returned in the result. Default value is 1

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the page to be returned. Default value is 50, maximum allowed is 250

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sorting is done against 'reconciliationDate'. Defaults to sorting in ascending order

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Filters ledger lines from given date. Filtering is performed against the reconciliation date of the ledger line. The parameter represents milliseconds since epoch date, but only the date part is taken into account. The time component is ignored

params.name: toDate
params.description: Filters ledger lines until given date. Filtering is performed against the reconciliation date of the ledger line. The parameter represents milliseconds since epoch date, but only the date part is taken into account. The time component is ignored

params.name: reconciliationType
params.description: Filters by ledger line reconciliation type

params.name: operationType
params.description: Filters by ledger line operation type

items.docs: Retrieve ledger lines generated for a specific role. Example, retrieve all ledger lines that a reseller manager has against all resellers
